bio.text: Jim Marchant, a Republican, is a candidate for Nevada secretary of state in the November 3, 2026 general election, a rematch with incumbent Cisco Aguilar (D), who defeated him in 2022.
He was elected to the Nevada State Assembly from District 37 in Las Vegas in 2016 and ran unsuccessfully for the U.S. House in Nevada's 4th District in 2020.
Born in Gainesville, Florida, he founded two early internet and telephone companies and served as president of the Federation of Internet Service Providers of America for six years.
